sections.name: summary
sections.value: Context brief. Purpose: store-backed number claims and a merge-time delivery verb (C23). Entrypoints: crates/store/src/{migrate,registry,community}.rs (begin_write, publish_tombstone, assignments), crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs (argv/caller wire, project_and_repo), crates/daemon/src/community/ddocs.rs (resolve-once pattern for gh), http/mod.rs seat_card (the card) and Endpoint table, crates/cli/src/{main,governance}.rs, the shim's RS_ROUTE_TABLE. Decisions: the PM's card gains a deliveries list (latest few PRs naming that seat as PM, one indexed read) and one delivered spine event carries the push; the PM is the live holder of pm-<roadmap number> from the step addresses, else --pm. Order: tk-0001 and tk-0002 first, tk-0003 and tk-0004 independent, then tk-0005 and tk-0006, then wiring, docs, cost and states. Tests: a scratch store, scratch main checkouts with numbered folders, a fake gh through Services; a private daemon for cost. Hazards: shared cargo target via just shared-build only; no node_modules (TS proof is CI); biome-format each ddocs write under docs/project.

value.title: Pure claim and delivery rules in pij-core
value.success: pij_core::claims: known kinds and widths (plan, prd, roadmap, blueprint, workshop 3; migration 4; other lowercase kinds 3), the main-checkout name patterns per kind, numbers named by a list of file paths, the PR body's Delivers line parsed into ddocs addresses, and the printed ddocs set edits (delivered_by appended as a comma-separated PR list, never overwritten; a step's plan cell).
value.notes: Pure: no IO. The daemon reads the files and gh; core decides.

value.title: Migration 0033 and the claims store
value.success: Migration 0033: claims (project, kind, number, seat, subject, claimed_at, released_at, released_by, release_reason; unique (project, kind, number)) and deliveries (project, pr, address, merge_commit, recorded_by, recorded_at, pm). claim() takes the next number under BEGIN IMMEDIATE as one more than the highest of the kind's claims (open or released) and the checkout floor; release() by the claiming seat or the prime; list per project.
value.notes: Pattern: streams.ordinal reserve under BEGIN IMMEDIATE (orchestration.rs). Number 0033 claimed for this plan; 0032 is plan 195's.

value.title: Release on tombstone
value.success: publish_tombstone releases the seat's open claims in the same transaction (reason seat-closed), so close, reap and revive all release.
value.notes: One UPDATE on an index of open claims by seat; no new launch or loop.

value.title: gh port resolved once at daemon start
value.success: community::gh: PIJ_GH, else PATH, absolute, decided once at start like ddocs (C10); one launch per call, recorded by the spawn counter as gh.delivered; a trait the tests replace with a fake. ping reports the gh path; just doctor prints it.
value.notes: Mirrors community::ddocs. Missing or unauthenticated gh refuses by name with the install or auth step.

value.title: pij claim, pij claims and pij claim release over HTTP
value.success: POST /v1/claim and /v1/claims on the governance argv/caller wire: the caller seat resolved by the identity ladder, the project from --project or the caller's repo, the checkout floor read in-process from the project's main checkout (docs/plans and docs/plans/archive, docs/project/prds|roadmaps|blueprints|workshops, crates/store/migrations). No launch.
value.notes: Reuses directory.rs project_and_repo. Refusals by name: bad kind, missing --for, release by another seat, unknown claim.

value.title: pij delivered and the PM's card
value.success: POST /v1/delivered <pr> [--project] [--pm <seat>]: one gh read (merged state, merge commit, body, files); refuses an unmerged PR or a body with no Delivers line by name; records the rows idempotently with one delivered event on the spine; releases claims whose numbers appear in the PR's files; prints the ddocs set edits and returns them in --json; posts on the PM's card (live holder of pm-<roadmap number>, else --pm, else says no PM was told). The state card gains a deliveries list read by one indexed query.
value.notes: Writes no project file and pushes nothing. delivered_by's current value is read in-process from the project's checkout so the edit appends.

value.title: CLI, shim and skill tables
value.success: pij-rs claim, claims and delivered forward argv like directory; the shim's RS_ROUTE_TABLE carries the three verbs; SKILL.md's CLI-verb coverage table has a row for them.
value.notes: TS proof is CI on the exact head (no node_modules here, C25).

value.title: Convention and API docs
value.success: Community procedures (README, prd, roadmap, blueprint) say to claim a number with pij claim and that every PR body carries a Delivers line; docs/project/README.md line 13 and the community README stop sending people to a PM or the prime for numbers; the PR template gains a Delivers line; docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents both verbs and their refusals.
value.notes: docs-system owns docs/project/** and the procedures; keep edits to what AC7 and AC9 name.

value.title: Cost receipts
value.success: Private daemon: spawn counter deltas around one claim (0), one claims list (0) and one delivered with a fake gh (1), with data.pid. Live fleet readings are taken by pm-001 after deploy.
value.notes: No loop, poll, timer or sweep is added.

value.title: Project states and gates
value.success: In this PR: roadmap s11 complete with plan docs/plans/196-claims-delivery; req-20 and req-21 shipped; c-claims and c-merge-delivery shipped. Scoped rust gate through just shared-build, main-checkout biome, local-path-check, lockfile-allowlist and just ddocs-check before the PR; the PR body carries a Delivers line.
value.notes: ddocs set then biome format on each project doc.

tk-0001.assertion: Unit tests: widths and kind validation; a Delivers line with requirement and step addresses parses, a body without one refuses by name; delivered_by '#110' plus #121 renders '#110, #121' and an existing #121 is not added twice.

tk-0002.assertion: cargo test -p pij-store claims: next number from claims and from the floor; ten concurrent claims for one (project, kind) get ten distinct consecutive numbers; two projects never interact; a released number is never reissued.

tk-0003.assertion: A store test tombstones the claiming seat and sees its open claims released with reason seat-closed while another seat's claim stays open; pij claims lists both states.

tk-0004.assertion: Resolution tests as for ddocs (PIJ_GH wins, must be absolute and executable, PATH fallback); spawn_sites.rs passes with the new launch site.

tk-0005.assertion: pij-daemon test on a private daemon and scratch checkout: claim returns the number after the highest folder, claims lists it with its seat, release by another seat refuses and by the claimer releases.

tk-0006.assertion: pij-daemon tests with a fake gh: a merged PR with a Delivers line records rows, prints ddocs set commands and shows on the PM's card (via --pm and via the pm-001 holder); a re-run records nothing new; an unmerged PR and a missing line refuse by name; the scratch checkout's git status stays clean.
The PM seat's state card carries the delivery after one call, and the spine holds one delivered event naming the PM.

tk-0007.assertion: cargo test -p pij-cli skill_verb_coverage passes with the three verbs; the TS shim coverage test passes in CI.

tk-0008.assertion: grep finds no 'Get the number from pm/001' or 'the prime hands numbers out' in the procedures or docs/project/README.md; just ddocs-check passes.

tk-0009.assertion: Receipts in assets/evidence show claim 0, claims 0 and delivered 1 launches on the private daemon.

tk-0010.assertion: ddocs validate is clean on the PRD, roadmap and blueprint; the scoped rust gate, biome, local-path-check, lockfile-allowlist and just ddocs-check pass on the PR head.
